candidate_scope: Read-only interim comparison of completed artifacts from running frozen6fb gold build. Record exact available identity; never call it current/v3 acceptance.
inputs: Frozen source labels, original source images, completed candidate Docling/document/text/chunk artifacts, scientific repair receipts, stage receipts. No full builds or model loads.
alignment: Match source PDF full hash and physical page. Resolve prepared-page mapping from saved artifact provenance or keeppages; do not assume physical and prepared indices coincide.
Locate the exact selected source expression using its crop geometry and local context, including specific caption/axis/table cell or prose occurrence. A matching token elsewhere is not evidence.
Record candidate item self_ref, provenance page/bbox, text and chunk identifiers when available; retain enough surrounding text to audit alignment.
If source region cannot be aligned confidently, report alignment_ambiguous rather than selecting a convenient match.
Use candidate geometry/provenance plus source context to distinguish source omission, output surface exclusion and incorrect text.
unit: One frozen selected source expression, not every repeated token or feature. Multiple variants of the same source expression are graded together; contradictory duplicates prevent a faithful result.

candidate_surface_denominators.docling_or_saved_text: All 23 source-verified expressions for which document extraction has finished and saved output is readable. Figure axis/footer stay in extraction denominator, but separately report class/surface rather than silently excluding.
candidate_surface_denominators.chunks: All 23 verified expressions in documents with completed chunking. Distinguish explicit documented surface exclusion, missing source passage, ambiguous alignment, and fidelity; do not silently exclude hard cases.
candidate_surface_denominators.embedding_and_serve: Only actual saved evidence can establish these surfaces. Do not infer actual embedding/served contents from chunks. Mark unavailable where no bounded replay is performed.

statuses.faithful: Exact aligned expression preserves required numeric values, sign/exponent attachment, unit, and semantic role; harmless encoding/spacing equivalent allowed; no contradictory copy.
statuses.corrupted: Aligned source expression is present but at least one required meaning feature is changed/lost or contradictory rendered copies coexist.
statuses.omitted: Extraction/chunking finished, relevant source passage/region is absent from expected surface after geometry/context inspection.
statuses.excluded_by_surface_policy: Evidence explicitly identifies intended exclusion (e.g. furniture/figure-interior text from chunkable prose); report separately and state whether operational recall denominator includes it.
statuses.alignment_ambiguous: Available output cannot be linked confidently to the frozen source region/context; no fidelity success counted.
statuses.pending: Required document/stage has not completed or stable artifact absent in live build.
statuses.unavailable: Surface not materialized or no direct bounded inspection available; no inference.
statuses.unscorable_source: The frozen transcriber-note-only range remains unscorable and is never replaced.

metrics.source_expression_fidelity: faithful / (faithful + corrupted) among confidently aligned emitted selected expressions; always display omitted, ambiguous, excluded, pending and unscorable counts separately. This is expression fidelity, not repair precision.
metrics.bounded_source_expression_recall: faithful / completed source-verified expressions, counting omissions/corruption/exclusions as not recovered; give surface and exact exclusions explicitly. Also report lower/upper bounds when alignment ambiguity prevents a point estimate.
metrics.expression_output_precision: Only defined if all candidate renderings aligned to the frozen selected regions are enumerated, including contradictory/spurious versions. Correct emitted expression renderings / all such renderings, separate from source recall; otherwise unavailable.
metrics.admitted_repair_precision: Only among source-aligned admitted scientific repair operations in these selected regions: source-correct operations / all admitted operations reviewed. Zero admitted operations yields undefined, not 100%. This selected-source operation subset is not representative of all repair proposals.
metrics.noop_correctness: For aligned expressions with adequate evidence that no scientific repair was admitted, faithful no-op expressions / confidently aligned no-op expressions; record missing receipt/noop uncertainty.
metrics.proposal_precision: Not measured without a separately frozen proposal population including rejected and admitted proposals.

source_scope_limits: Three inverse-volume exponents belong to one paper.
Four footnote controls are negative scientific-repair controls.
One retained source-note-only case is unscorable.
Stratified capped sample is not corpus-representative.
immutability: No writes to live gold artifacts or frozen labels/crops. This directory contains separate receipts, read-only captured excerpts and comparison results.
